additional_info.subject: ID0466141-DC/Si-D/AE-[Multi] Investigate Charger's Performance CRM:00314000248
additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0466141.
The ticket has been opened by End Customer Mr.Nadeem Manaf, asking for a fleet investigation in terms of charging performance.
I am reaching out to you, as such requests needs to be addressed firstly by the local Siemens Team, in order to directly support, channel the communication, mitigate the expectation with the customer, and streamline the activities according to the ongoing processes and tools.
Let me please provide you with a summary of the current constraints:
UAEV is asking to provide an overview of the charging performances of their fleet
Customer reported 26 chargers IDs, and
all of them
are
registered as
Out of Warranty
in ISP.
Customer asked to perform a performance evaluation in terms of correct working of all power modules and also in terms of power drops.
At the moment, from Siemens HQ side we do not have the tools to perform such type of performance and monitoring overview of charging session and charging curves.
From Siemens HQ side we can, at the moment, check the performance of a charger only when specific timestamps are provided. With timestamps, we could verify if in that occasion a power module was giving an error, or if any power drop happened and for a specific reason.
Usually, from the OCPP Backend it is possible to have an overview, per charger or per fleet, of the charging curves and power delivered over a period of time.
Based on the previous considerations, I would suggest some action items that should be followed according to the process:
Please support the End Customer and verify if from their side it is possible to have an overview of the charger performances in their OCPP Backend.
If specific events are identified, please support the end customer to collect and organize the data. It is important, in case an analysis is requested to us, to have data organized per charger, with precise timestamps and symptoms.
After all these checks from your side, if you require the support from TS, it will be necessary to evaluate the efforts and we will present you with an offer, being all the chargers out of warranty.
Hope I provided you with clarification on the customer's request and the next steps that should be followed for you to support the customer.
Therefore, I am moving the case
0466141
﻿from the Technical Support to the
eMobility RC-AE SI E Queue
.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-AE SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer
SI E EU CS TS
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
mailto:fosco.servidei@siemens.com
www.siemens.com
Important notice: This e-mail and any attachment thereof contain corporate proprietary information. If you have received it by mistake, please notify us immediately by reply e-mail and delete this e-mail and its attachments from your system.
Thank you.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0466141-DC/Si-D/AE-[Multi] Investigate Charger's Performance CRM:00314000248
additional_info.body:
Dear Fosco,
I would like to highlight their concern more precisely: they are experiencing power reduction/drop on a few chargers, as reported by customers to UAEV.
To move forward effectively rather than conducting a full performance review of all chargers, which is not feasible I recommend requesting detailed information for the specific charger(s) affected, including the relevant timestamps. This will allow us to investigate the issue thoroughly and propose an appropriate resolution.
I will coordinate with UAEV and get back to you soon.
Regards
Syed Basheeruddin
